_meta.title: the species genome of the ladder (front 32b)
_meta.instrument: fw32_genome.py — pure register fusion, zero downloads

honesty.scope: the genome covers every species TOUCHED by a frontier event; the never-touched static core is not enumerable from registers (per-rung GUID sets were computed in-session from binaries, only counts + frontier events persisted)
honesty.names: frontier events carry name=null; the 665-entry GUID-name join map body was not persisted (map_size only) — names join in only at the armor quartet via the atlas gates
honesty.cross_vendor: cross-vendor body/GUID sets not persisted per board; only pairwise jaccards + symbolic armor joins survive
honesty.hash_chain_semantics: moves count frontier events where the body hash changed; from/to are truncated 16-hex body hashes as persisted by ring 23
